title: Coefficient augmentation is closed
statement: For any scheme X [def-pc-scheme], finite indexed family of opens U, injective resolution I [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], natural n, and degree-n cycle z in the unit-module Cech complex [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change], the total differential in degrees n,n+1 kills additiveCechBeta U I n applied to the inclusion of z [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization].

proof.text:
Identify the unit module on each finite open intersection with its additive
structural sections using restrictFunctorGamma and lift by ULift. Naturality of
this identification and of the resolution augmentation identifies the horizontal
differential of beta(z) with beta of the coefficient differential of z, hence zero.
The vertical differential is zero because the resolution augmentation is killed
by its first differential. The total differential is the sum of these two
components, with the standard sign on the vertical component, so it vanishes.
The argument applies in degree zero and to empty or repeated intersections; it
does not require a covering or an affine acyclicity hypothesis.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight generic quasi-isomorphism results, including quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap and isoOfQuasiIsoAt. No Cech-specific augmentation construction.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Generic homology APIs are useful for the parent proof, but do not prove this augmentation statement.

Cech complex augmentation of an injective sheaf is a quasi-isomorphism
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including InjectiveResolution.quasiIso and instQuasiIsoIntι', but no explicit open-cover augmentation into a total complex.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No replacement for either explicit augmentation statement.
These provide total-complex tools, not the restriction chain map or coefficient closedness.

mathlib_searches.results: Generic total-complex differential identities. Local rg also read EtaleOpenCechResolutionTotal and EtaleAdditiveCechAugmentationHomology. The former constructs a restriction map privately and exposes only a nonempty homology isomorphism; the latter assumes affine intersections. Neither supplies the prescribed augmentation interface under the present hypotheses.
mathlib_searches.verdict: No duplicate of the new statements; completing them still requires compatibility of the explicit maps.

theorem etaleAdditiveCech_beta_closed
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) (n : ℕ)
    (z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n) :
    (additiveCechTotal U I).d n (n + 1)
      (additiveCechBeta U I n
        ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z)) = 0
